استرجعن (form X)
# اِسْتَرْجَعْنَ (istarjaʕna) /is.tar.d͡ʒaʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَرْجَعَ (istarjaʕa)
# اُسْتُرْجِعْنَ (usturjiʕna) /us.tur.d͡ʒiʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْجَعَ (istarjaʕa)
# اِسْتَرْجِعْنَ (istarjiʕna) /is.tar.d͡ʒiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْجَعَ (istarjaʕa)
